schema_notes: default_model=null means 'let orchestrator dynamic selection decide'.
Escalation ratchet: 3 corrections → opus-lock. Deescalation: 5 consecutive successful sonnet tasks with zero corrections → reset to sonnet.
Agent-factory upgrade clears all ratchet state (default_model, both counters, pending_upgrade).

v2.9.0 extends the file into a unified resource-index. Top-level agents block is unchanged (roster owns agent task-tracking). New siblings: skills (auto-populated by /prism-index from ~/.claude/skills/ + plugin skills), tools (resolved from tools-registry.md install state), mcps (from Claude Code mcpServers). Blueprint-prompt and master-orchestrator query all four blocks before panel assembly / subagent dispatch. Skills/tools/mcps entries are DISCOVERY metadata only — no task-tracking, no escalation ratchets, no NotebookLM notebooks.

v3.1.0 adds optional team_id field per agent. null = global/no team. String = arbitrary team identifier (e.g., 'platform-team', 'eng-uk'). /prism-roster --team <id> filters display to matching agents. Tier 3 visibility lever — surgical, no auth model implied. Admin convention: keep team_ids consistent across team's installs.

v4.1 adds the optional domain_groups block (top-level sibling to agents/skills/tools/mcps). Populated by /prism-index from agent.core_domains + skill.domains arrays — groups resources by shared domain so /prism-roster --by-domain can render a coverage view. domain_groups is DERIVED data: re-run /prism-index after agent/skill changes to refresh. Schema example at _schema_example_domain_group.

v4.4 adds optional per-agent flags requires_phase_1_5 (boolean, default false) and requires_phase_1_5_block (boolean, default false). When requires_phase_1_5 is true, the SubagentStop hook hooks/prism-phase-1-5-oob.mjs invokes an out-of-band reviewer via direct Anthropic SDK call to produce an independent PHASE 1.5 verdict. requires_phase_1_5_block: true makes the hook synchronous (master pauses until verdict completes). Legacy agents (missing fields) are treated as both false. See docs/prism/plans/2026-05-26-v4.4-implementation-plan.md.

v4.5 adds optional per-agent flags phase_1_5_lite_oob (boolean, default false) and skip_next_oob (boolean, ephemeral, auto-cleared). phase_1_5_lite_oob enables O1 LITE mode for the OOB Phase 1.5 reviewer — cheaper, faster, still independent. skip_next_oob is a one-shot kill switch: when true the next OOB review is skipped and the flag is immediately cleared. Both default to false/absent (falsy) for legacy agents. v4.5 Layer 2 — rationale: OOB reviewer cost control + V1 emergency bypass.

_schema_example_agent.__comment: Agent entries: full task-tracking + escalation state. Created only by agent-factory (heavyweight path) or /prism-roster --reconcile (orphan recovery). Orchestrator ignores keys starting with underscore.

_schema_example_skill.__comment: Skill entries: discovery metadata only. Populated by /prism-index from scanning ~/.claude/skills/ and ~/.claude/plugins/*/skills/. Never hand-edited — re-run /prism-index to refresh.

_schema_example_tool.__comment: Tool entries: resolved from tools-registry.md with install-status probe. Populated by /prism-index.

_schema_example_mcp.__comment: MCP entries: from .claude.json mcpServers + ~/.claude/settings.json mcpServers. Populated by /prism-index.

_schema_example_domain_group.__comment: Domain-group entries: keyed by lowercase-kebab domain tag. Aggregates agent + skill names that declare this domain in their core_domains / domains arrays. Re-derived on every /prism-index run; never hand-edited. Used by /prism-roster --by-domain.

_schema_pilot_v4_4.__comment: v4.4 OOB PHASE 1.5 reviewer pilot guidance. Pilot tagging is per-install (not shipped with default roster.json). Recommended pilot specialists: @claude-master, @code-reviewer, @security-architect. To enable OOB review for an agent, add 'requires_phase_1_5: true' to its agent entry. Block-mode (requires_phase_1_5_block: true) is reserved for agents whose output drives an irreversible downstream action.
